title: Coemi Imóveis
description: coemi.com.br Coemi Imóveis is a Brazilian real estate agency founded in 1985 in Brasília with 41 years of experience in buying, selling, renting and property management across the Federal District and Goiás state. It operates three offices including its Asa Norte headquarters, an Águas Claras branch and a new Goiânia unit opened in 2023, with 18 to 33 employees and a portfolio of over 1,500 rental properties. The company is an official correspondent of Caixa Econômica Federal for mortgage financing and a member of the Rede Brasília de Imóveis network. Its services cover personalized sales consulting, rental management with differentiated payment options, property evaluation and legal support through to notarial closing. It runs a free online property valuation tool and actively publishes market guides for Brasília neighborhoods. Led by a single owner and registered under Simples Nacional as a small enterprise with R$78,800 in share capital.
